identificationModule.briefTitle: Rituximab Plus Lenalidomide for Patients With Relapsed / Refractory Indolent Non-Hodgkin's Lymphoma (Follicular Lymphoma and Marginal Zone Lymphoma)
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase 3, Double-blind, Randomized Study to Compare the Efficacy and Safety of Rituximab Plus Lenalidomide (CC-5013) Versus Rituximab Plus Placebo in Subjects With Relapsed/Refractory Indolent Lymphoma

armGroups.label: Rituximab and Lenalidomide
armGroups.description: Participants received rituximab 375 mg/m\^2 intravenously (IV) every week in Cycle 1 (Days 1, 8, 15 and 22) and on Day 1 of every 28-day cycle from Cycles 2 to 5 plus lenalidomide 20 mg by mouth (PO) once daily on Days 1 to 21 every 28 days, up to 12 cycles (21-day treatment and 7-day rest period); if creatinine clearance (CrCl) was ≥ 30 mL/min but \< 60 mL/min, participants received lenalidomide 10 mg capsules on days 1 to 21 every 28 days.

armGroups.label: Rituximab and Placebo
armGroups.description: Participants received riituximab 375 mg/m\^2 IV every week in Cycle 1 (Days 1, 8, 15 and 22) and on Day 1 of every 28-day cycle from cycle 2 to 5 plus placebo (identically matched capsule) once daily on Days 1 to 21 of every 28-day cycle up, to 12 cycles.

interventions.name: Rituximab
interventions.description: Rituximab 375mg/m\^2 IV every week in Cycle 1 (Days 1, 8, 15 and 22) on Day 1 of every 28 day cycle from Cycles 2 to 5

interventions.name: Lenalidomide
interventions.description: Lenalidomide 20mg by mouth (PO) daily on Days 1 to 21 every 28 days up to 12 cycles

interventions.name: Placebo
interventions.description: Placebo (identical matched capsule) PO daily on Days 1 to 21 every 28 days
